s0: ^Town Guard: Armor feels light enough on the first day. By the third, it’s like hauling the whole bloody wall on your back.
s1: ^Town Guard: Keep your boots dry, lad. A single blister’s no small matter—my cousin nearly lost a foot to rot from one.
s2: ^Town Guard: I’ve no patience for bards. They sing of battles as though they fought them, yet all they know are the pretty lies of those who never bled. Clever folk, in their way.
